posts.title: Why I'm taking on this challenge
posts.body:
When I did my undergrad I dipped in and out of being a vergetarian, fortunate that I was brought up with a lot of veggie food so it didn't seem too intimidating. When I was studying I saw an article that discussed Cambridge attempting to go fully plant based. I was pretty shocked at the idea, but it did make me stop and think about my own eating habits - wanting to make more effort to change and adapt my own eating habits. 

Since then I've learned lots of plant based recipes and I've grown more confident in my own diet and cooked for some of my friends too!

But, I find activism and discussing these changes with others very intimidating and I really prefer to avoid confrontation. That's why I am taking on this challenge, and trying to push myself to talk to people and try and spread the campaigns mission!

Over the coming months I'll be working with Plant-Based Cambridge to get academics signing the open letter, and sharing resources to help anyone who wants to make the switch.
